description: This file contains the implementation of a file-based storage provider for Orleans, including the main class 'OrleansFileStorage' and an internal class 'GrainStateFileDataManager' that handles file system interactions for storing, reading, and deleting grain state data.

classes.name: OrleansFileStorage
classes.description: A storage provider class for Orleans that uses the file system to persist grain state, configured with a root directory.

classes.name: GrainStateFileDataManager
classes.description: Handles file system operations such as reading, writing, and deleting grain state files within a specified directory.

methods.name: OrleansFileStorage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the storage provider with a root directory and sets up the data manager.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the file corresponding to a specific grain state identified by collection name and key.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads the contents of the file representing a grain state object.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to a file representing a grain state object.

methods.name: GetStorageFilePath
methods.description: Generates the file path for storing or retrieving a grain state based on collection name and key.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Placeholder for cleanup, currently does nothing.
